html:
G'oya

Ikki jadvaldagi shaharlarni bitta ro'yxatga takrorsiz yig'ish kerak. UNION aynan shuni qiladi: ikki so'rov natijasini ustma-ust qo'yadi va bir xil qatorlarni bittaga aylantiradi. Takror ikki jadval orasida ham (Samarqandda Malika ham, Sut Savdo ham bor), bitta jadval ichida ham (Toshkentda Aziz va Bekzod) olib tashlanadi.

Yechim

SELECT city FROM customers WHERE city IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT city FROM suppliers WHERE city IS NOT NULL

NULL filtri ikkala qismda ham kerak: WHERE faqat o'z SELECTiga tegishli. Natija ustunining nomi birinchi so'rovdan olinadi.

Tuzoqlar

UNION ALL takrorlarni olib tashlamaydi. Namunada Toshkent ham, Samarqand ham ikki martadan chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT city FROM customers WHERE city IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT city FROM suppliers WHERE city IS NOT NULL

NULLni unutsangiz, natijada bitta bo'sh qator paydo bo'ladi. To'plam amallarida NULLlar bir-biriga teng hisoblanadi, shuning uchun Dilnozaning va boshqa shahari yo'q yozuvlarning hammasi bitta NULL qatorga birlashadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT city FROM customers
UNION
SELECT city FROM suppliers

Boshqa yo'l

Avval UNION ALL bilan hammasini yig'ib, keyin tashqarida DISTINCT va NULL filtrini bir marta yozish ham mumkin:

SELECT DISTINCT city
FROM (
  SELECT city FROM customers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT city FROM suppliers
) t
WHERE city IS NOT NULL
